objective: Shortest safe path to Production/E2E with each question mastered once before upload.
immutableRules: CROP is CLOSED at 2135/2135; reopen only for a proven crop defect.
A source group/title is provenance only and never sufficient evidence for exact canonical skill.

Each question is mastered in one pass: provenance + canonical main/subskill + correctAnswer + stepByStepSolution + educationalExplanation + difficulty + difficultyReason + imageHash + contentFingerprint + ideaFingerprint.
Unclear evidence is HOLD/REVIEW fail-closed; continue immediately with the next question.
No new skills outside canonical 25 main / 95 subskills.
No production/R2 upload while QUESTION_MASTERING, QA_LOCK or DEDUPE_LOCK is open.
A PASS+LOCK stage is not reopened unless a documented defect invalidates its evidence.

stages.name: QUESTION_MASTERING
stages.gate: Every non-HOLD record has the complete one-pass master payload.

stages.name: QA_LOCK
stages.gate: Independent full-book question↔answer↔solution↔skill consistency and required-fields QA.

stages.name: DEDUPE_LOCK
stages.gate: Full MNSF26 internal + FND26(858) + COL2627(946), imageHash plus content/idea fingerprints; no imageHash-only suppression.

stages.name: R2_UPLOAD_LOCK
stages.gate: Presign/upload + remote SHA verification; persist imageUrl/imageHash/cropStatus.

stages.name: IMPORT_LOCK
stages.gate: verify:mnsf26:all full-book → dry-run → canary5 → verify → full draft import → integrity/live-image.

stages.name: PRODUCTION_E2E_LOCK
stages.gate: Production learner/results/reporting paths verified and documented.

execution: Work source-order in large batches. Save checkpoints to GitHub but do not treat commits as stage completion. Update MNSF26_EXECUTION_STATE_V1.json after every substantial batch.
